## Nishida Kitaro on experience

Nishida Kitaro (1870–1945) approaches experience within Kyoto School. Early Nishida treats pure experience as immediate knowing prior to subject–object split, and the good as realization of personality. Mature Nishida relocates reality in the self-determining place of absolute nothingness: individuals arise as determinations of that place. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets experience most directly—useful for searches such as “nishida kitaro quotes on experience.”
